notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
number is the printed card number (n/10). The extracted file order is not the printed order: cards are listed by printed number.
orientation: 'inverted' = printed upside down on the card (secrets, R-15.82, and some assets).

variants: a section without reputation subsections has a single variant with condition null. 'flavor' is the italic text; 'text' is the rules text. Several printed paragraphs are one string separated by '\n'.
The second section of every card is the Maelstrom (planet: 'The Maelstrom').
Die icons: solid starburst = {HIT}, outlined spiky starburst = {CRIT}, eye = {FOCUS}.
Embedded cargo assets keep the printed trait in 'traits' (ILLEGAL -> illegal).

variants.flavor: The mines always have plenty of spice. Now you just need to find a buyer.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the cargo below. If you have {REP_POS} Syndicate reputation, you may gain the cargo by spending {CREDITS}1,000 instead.

variants.flavor: You encounter a large scattering of debris.
variants.text: Test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 2 damage.

asset.name: Spice
text: To deliver, roll a die. On a {HIT}, deliver this. Otherwise, resolve card #1.

variants.flavor: While visiting a remote station, you see an opportunity to free some slaves from the mines.
variants.text: You may test Stealth. If you pass, gain 1 fame and lose 2 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your character suffers 4 damage.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: Your new “friends” ask for credits.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}2,000 to gain 1 Syndicate reputation.

variants.flavor: An electrical storm knocks out your power systems.
variants.text: Your ship suffers 1 damage. Test Tech. If you pass, recover up to 2 damage from your ship and take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space.

variants.flavor: Unrefined coaxium is very unstable and is known to spontaneously explode. Is the payout worth it?
variants.text: You may lose 1 Syndicate reputation or spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain the cargo below.

variants.flavor: You nearly fly into a giant space-faring beast.
variants.text: Test Piloting or Knowledge. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 3 damage.

asset.name: Unrefined Coaxium
text: At the end of your action step, roll a die. On a {CRIT}, discard this card and your ship suffers 4 damage.

verify: Unrefined Coaxium: the die icon in 'On a [icon]' is the outlined spiky starburst, read as {CRIT} (the Spice cargo uses the solid one, {HIT}).

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: It seems that someone is selling stolen goods here.
variants.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed ILLEGAL cargo with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: You have the opportunity to influence a Pyke capo.
variants.text: You may spend {CREDITS}3,000 to gain 1 Syndicate reputation.

variants.flavor: A chunk of debris is flying straight toward you.
variants.text: Test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and discard 1 of your mods. If you did not have a mod, your ship suffers 3 damage.

variants.flavor: It seems that everyone has a hand in the local slave trade. Will you stand by or will you act?
variants.text:
You may lose 2 Hutt, 2 Imperial, or 2 Syndicate reputation to gain 1 fame. (You can only do this if you had {REP_POS} reputation with that faction.)
If you do not gain fame, you may discard 1 of your crew to gain {CREDITS}3,000 and 1 Syndicate reputation.

variants.flavor: An Imperial TIE fighter has followed you into the Maelstrom. You’ll need to destroy it before you can escape.
variants.text: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation, fight a ship combat against a TIE fighter ({SHIP_COMBAT} 3). If you lose, move 1 space. If you win or did not resolve a combat, move 1 space and then take an additional turn.

variants.flavor: The Pyke syndicate wants you to send a message to the Hutts.
variants.text: You may take the “Syndicate Favor” job card from another player or the {DECK_JOB} market deck. If you take it from the {DECK_JOB} deck, shuffle that deck.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: A Pyke capo fears that the workers may be planning a revolt and asks for you to spy on them.
variants.text: You may test Stealth. If you pass, gain 1 Syndicate reputation. If you fail, your character suffers 2 damage.

variants.flavor: The nebula’s gases render your sensors ineffective.
variants.text: Test Piloting or Tech. If you pass, take an additional turn.

variants.flavor: The Pykes are looking for a trustworthy smuggler.
variants.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed ILLEGAL cargo for free. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Syndicate reputation:
variants.flavor: No one hauls illegal cargo through this sector without Pyke approval.
variants.text: If you do not have any cargo, you may move 1 space. Otherwise, lose {CREDITS}3,000 and gain 1 Syndicate reputation.

variants.flavor: A massive tentacle grasps at your ship.
variants.text: Fight a ship combat against a creature ({SHIP_COMBAT} 4). If you win, prevent all damage from this combat and take an additional turn. If you lose, move 1 space.

variants.flavor: Criminals may respect a wanted outlaw, but they’ll still turn you in for a reward.
variants.text:
You may lose 1 reputation from a faction you have {REP_NEU} reputation with.
Gain {CREDITS}3,000 for each faction you have {REP_NEG} reputation with. Then, for each faction you have {REP_NEG} reputation with, move that faction’s patrol 4 spaces toward you.

variants.flavor: The Maelstrom makes for a good spot for an ambush.
variants.text:
You may move 1 patrol directly to your space and encounter it. During the combat, you add 1 {CRIT}. After the combat, move 1 space.
If you do not fight a combat, test Piloting. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and your ship suffers 3 damage.

verify: Kessel: 'a faction you have [icon] reputation with' in the first sentence is the empty (flat outlined) hexagon, read as {REP_NEU}; the next two are filled, read as {REP_NEG}.
Maelstrom: 'you add 1 [icon]' is the outlined spiky starburst, read as {CRIT}.

variants.flavor: In crime, as in any business, it’s more about who you know than what you know.
variants.text: You may lose 1 reputation from a faction you have {REP_POS} reputation with to gain {CREDITS}4,000. If you do, you may lose 1 reputation from another faction you have {REP_POS} reputation with to gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: A gravity well is pulling you backward. If you could lose some weight, you might escape unscathed.
variants.text: You may discard 1 of your cargo or mods to take an additional turn. If you do not discard a card, move 1 space and your ship suffers 1 damage.

variants.flavor: The Pykes demand that you prove that you are loyal to them, and them alone.
variants.text: You may lose any amount of Hutt, Rebel, and Imperial reputation. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} Hutt, {REP_NEG} Rebel, and {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, gain 1 fame and 1 Syndicate reputation.

variants.flavor: You fly too close to an asteroid and rip your hull open. You’re losing air fast.
variants.text: Test Tech. If you pass, take an additional turn. If you fail, move 1 space and discard 1 of your crew. If you did not have a crew, your character suffers 3 damage.
